subject: math

objective.text: Draw a tape diagram to show equal groups. Write repeated addition to find the total.

explanations.title: Parts and whole in a tape diagram
explanations.text: A tape diagram has boxes. Each box is a part. When you know the parts, you add them to find the whole. 2 plus 3 plus 1 equals 6.

explanations.title: Boxes are groups
explanations.text: Each box is one group. The number inside the box is how many are in that group. 3 boxes with 2 in each box is 3 groups of 2.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (S: boxes represent the groups)

explanations.title: Add the same unit again
explanations.text: With equal groups you add the same number again and again. 2 plus 2 plus 2 equals 6. We are adding twos. We can add units of 2, 5 or any number.

explanations.title: Make the boxes equal
explanations.text: Boxes can start with different numbers, like 2, 3, 5 and 2. Move counters so every box has 3. Now there are 4 equal groups of 3.

explanations.title: Swap the groups and the number in each
explanations.text: 4 groups of 3 and 3 groups of 4 both equal 12. For 3 groups of 4, draw 3 boxes and write 4 in each box.

examples.title: Apples in three bags
examples.text: Jane has 2 apples, Sam has 3 and Ann has 1. Add the parts: 2 plus 3 plus 1 equals 6. The whole is 6.

examples.title: 3 groups of 2
examples.text: 3 boxes with 2 in each box. 2 plus 2 plus 2 equals 6. 3 groups of 2 equals 6.

examples.title: 4 groups of 3
examples.text: 4 boxes with 3 in each box. 3 plus 3 plus 3 plus 3 equals 12. You can use doubles: 6 plus 6 equals 12.

examples.title: 4 groups of 5
examples.text: 4 boxes with 5 in each box. The 4 boxes are the 4 groups. The 5 is how many are in each group. 5 plus 5 plus 5 plus 5 equals 20.

assets_required.why_this_method: Exact box counts, numbers or counters inside each box, and moving counters between boxes need exact behaviour. Diffusion cannot count.
assets_required.description: A row of joined boxes (a tape diagram). Each box holds counters or a number. A bracket can show the total.
must_show_exactly: Each box shows stimulus.per_group, either as that many counters or as the number
Unequal start states use the listed group sizes (for example 2, 3, 5, 2)
Total shown only when the question allows it
assets_required.interaction: Tutor sets boxes and contents from the stimulus. Child can move counters between boxes. Child answers by voice or typing.
assets_required.alt_text: A tape diagram of joined boxes with counters or numbers in each box.
assets_required.generation_caption: Flat tape diagram: a row of equal joined rectangles, same number of dots or the same number in each, plain background. [Build by code]
